UI049: streaming SHA256+length matches physical content, never customer identity; bounded root-union removes nested traversals; disjoint persisted source/customer/style IDs stay independent; snapshot-digest and source-revision CAS plus SQLite transaction make stale context or audit failure roll back all location changes.
